description: This file implements the RegexpCondition class, a part of the Apache OFBiz MiniLang framework. It provides functionality for a conditional check based on matching a string against a regular expression within a custom mini-language, including parsing of XML elements defining such conditions and executing associated sub-operations.

classes.name: RegexpCondition
classes.description: Implements a conditional operation that evaluates to true if the specified field matches the given regular expression pattern. It supports executing nested operations based on the outcome and can process 'else' blocks. It also includes methods for condition checking, execution, artifact info gathering, and pretty printing.

methods.name: RegexpCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the condition from an XML element and the associated simple method, parsing attributes and child elements for sub-operations.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates if the specified field value matches the regular expression pattern expanded from 'expr'. Uses the PatternFactory to compile the regex and Perl5Matcher for matching.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the condition, running nested operations if the condition holds true, or 'else' sub-operations if it does not.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information from nested operations for analysis or documentation purposes.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Provides a human-readable representation of the condition's evaluation parameters.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the <if-regexp> element for debugging or logging.

methods.name: createCondition
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of RegexpCondition from an XML element.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method for creating method operations of this type.
